text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hmm, what a pickle...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan? What's the matter?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Laurel-senpai! Actually, I'm having 
trouble finding someone to practice the 
hero show with.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai and Pearl-senpai said they 
had plans... So I'm looking for someone to 
play the villain instead, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
In that case, want me to be your opponent? 
Playing the villain sounds kind of fun!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Really!? In that case, I'll ask 
Laurel-senpai to play the role of the evil 
executive!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Champion of justice and friend to all good 
kids, Justice Biko is here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —I am the evil executive, Queen Laurel!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Everything in this world belongs to us! We 
won't show any mercy to anyone who stands 
in our way!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Laurel-senpai, I want a cooler line 
to say.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was that not enough?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Villains need their own 'uncompromising 
principles,' you know. Just like a hero's 
sense of justice, you need conviction to 
see villainy through.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Clashing while carrying that weight is 
what makes the battle between justice and 
evil so fiery!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Playing a villain actually has a 
lot of depth to it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
What Queen Laurel can never compromise on, 
huh... âYeah, I'll think about it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel came up with her own villain 
backstory and channeled it into her lines. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"—This world is a suffocating miniature 
garden. My mission is salvation through 
destruction."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Illuminated by the dark sun, the flower of 
evil blooms enchantingly—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—The graceful bloom of evil, Queen Laurel! 
I shall scatter this world in magnificent 
splendor!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Amazing, Laurel-senpai! You've really 
got the commanding presence of a villain 
down!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Really!? What a relief! Thank you, 
Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, playing the villain is so fun. I 
could get used to this♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel broke new ground with Queen 
Laurel. After this experience, her running 
became sharper than ever before.
